properties.description:

Carolina...

Henderson and Transylvania Counties.

rainfall will maintain flooding along the French Broad River.

* WHEN...Until late Monday night.

tomorrow afternoon.

feet on 01/03/1937.

properties.description:

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Marion, Citrus and Levy
Counties.

elevated and could reach minor flood stage in the next few days.

next few days.
- Flood stage is 28.2 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.2
feet on 10/02/1979.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
